{{AnimeLocationInfobox |name=Mount Tensei |image=Mount Tensei.png |imagesize=250px |characters=テンセイ山 |japanese=Mount Tensei |epicode=M20 |episode=I Choose You! |colorscheme=SM }} '''Mount Tensei''' (Japanese: '''テンセイ{{ruby|山|ざん}}''' ''Mount Tensei'') is an {{pkmn|animated series}}-exclusive location and one of the settings for ''[[M20|I Choose You!]]''. It is the highest peak in the '''Raizen Mountain Range''' or the '''Raizen Mountains''' (Japanese: '''ライゼン{{ruby|山脈|さんみゃく}}''' ''Raizen Mountains''). When {{p|Marshadow}} is obtained through [[Mystery Gift]], it mentions that the OT (Original Trainer) is MT. Tensei.
